title: Full review
practiceFocus: A 5–10 minute self-introduction and daily-life story

points.title: Three time frames
points.rule: Reuse only what you can already say. Present for who you are and your routine: soy, vivo, trabajo, me levanto. Estar for right now: estoy. Yesterday as the chunks from day 13: fui, hice, comí, vi, tuve. If a sentence needs anything else, describe around the missing word and keep talking.

examples.english: Who you are and your routine.
Where you are and how you feel.

grammar.notYet: Any pattern you cannot use in the 5–10 minute story.

phrases.spanish: Hola, me llamo Alex. Vivo en Londres.
phrases.english: Hi, my name is Alex. I live in London.
I work as a software engineer.

phrases.spanish: Me gusta correr y estudiar español.
phrases.english: I like to run and study Spanish.

phrases.spanish: Por la mañana me levanto y desayuno.
phrases.english: In the morning I get up and have breakfast.

phrases.spanish: Ayer fui al trabajo y tuve reuniones.
phrases.english: Yesterday I went to work and had meetings.

phrases.spanish: Quiero un café y algo de comer.
phrases.english: I want a coffee and something to eat.

phrases.spanish: Mi familia es pequeña. Tengo una hermana.
phrases.english: My family is small. I have a sister.

phrases.spanish: Vivo cerca de la estación. Voy en metro.
phrases.english: I live near the station. I go by metro.

phrases.spanish: Ahora estoy en casa y estoy bien.
phrases.english: Right now I am at home and I am well.

phrases.spanish: No entiendo. Más despacio, por favor.
phrases.english: I do not understand. More slowly, please.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Hola. Me llamo Alex. Soy de Londres y trabajo como ingeniero.
lines.english: Hi. My name is Alex. I am from London and I work as an engineer.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Hoy es jueves. Me levanto a las siete y trabajo desde casa.
lines.english: Today is Thursday. I get up at seven and work from home.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: A la una como algo simple. Por la tarde hago ejercicio.
lines.english: At one I eat something simple. In the afternoon I exercise.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Ayer fui a un restaurante con un amigo. Comí una ensalada.
lines.english: Yesterday I went to a restaurant with a friend. I ate a salad.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Estoy un poco cansado, pero estoy bien. Me gusta estudiar español todos los días.
lines.english: I am a bit tired, but I am well. I like studying Spanish every day.

practice.title: Your two-week story
practice.instruction: Give a 5–10 minute self-introduction and daily-life story. Cover who you are, today, family, food, and yesterday.
starters: Hola, me llamo… Vivo en… Trabajo como…
tips: This is the point of the two weeks: using Spanish, not finishing grammar.
If a word is missing, describe around it and keep talking.
